title: Synthetic Data in Marketing Research: How to Evaluate and When to Trust
abstract: arXiv:2609.13995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Debate over synthetic data in marketing research has polarized between claims that large language models (LLMs) make human respondents obsolete and calls to avoid them entirely. We argue that both positions obscure the more useful question: not whether synthetic respondents work, but when. Building on Brand, Israeli, and Ngwe (2026), we make three contributions. First, we distinguish three types of synthetic data (ungrounded LLM responses, segment-level personas, and individual-level digital twins) and map each to the decisions it can support. Second, we develop a taxonomy of four families of accuracy measures and suggest that the wide range of reported twin accuracy, from near-perfect to near-chance, largely reflects differences in what is being measured rather than in method quality. Aggregate measures often perform well even when little information is supplied to the LLM, and can mask a complete absence of respondent-level differentia

translated_title: 营销研究中的合成数据：如何评估以及何时信任
translated_abstract: 关于营销研究中合成数据的争论已经两极分化：一方声称大语言模型（LLM）使人类受访者变得过时，另一方则呼吁完全避免使用合成数据。我们认为，这两种立场都掩盖了更有意义的问题：不是合成受访者是否有效，而是何时有效。基于Brand、Israeli和Ngwe（2026）的研究，我们做出了三项贡献。首先，我们区分了三种类型的合成数据（无依据的LLM回答、细分群体层面的虚拟角色、个体层面的数字孪生），并将每种类型映射到其能够支持的决策。其次，我们建立了一个包含四大类准确性度量的分类体系，并指出所报告的数字孪生准确性之所以范围极广——从近乎完美到近乎随机——很大程度上反映了所测量内容的不同，而非方法质量的差异。总体层面的度量即使在向LLM提供极少信息的情况下也往往表现良好，并可能掩盖受访者层面差异性的完全缺失。
tldr: 本文区分了三种合成数据类型并建立了四类准确性评估分类体系，指出合成数据的问题不在于是否有效而在于何时可用，且总体层面的高准确性可能掩盖受访者层面差异性的完全缺失。
en_tdlr: This paper distinguishes three types of synthetic data and develops a four-family taxonomy of accuracy measures, arguing that the key question is not whether synthetic respondents work but when to trust them, and that strong aggregate accuracy can mask a complete absence of respondent-level differentiation.
